intro: FinAtlas 是以台灣與美國為主的金融產業與職涯學習指南。從金融地圖的 7 個領域出發，沿著融資與市場、投資與保障、運作與控管三條分支，連結 22 個職位、9 個科系與 27 個課程主題，找到自己的學習路線。
53 課依共同基礎、市場制度、職位方法與實作安排，每課都有「任務、理解、帶做、實作」入口，可接續上次步驟。16 組單變數計算練習能核對答案、查看解析，並依課程與市場保存作答；也可用測驗、筆記與收藏整理學習。
選擇台灣、美國或台美比較，將市場背景帶入相關工作簿與能力分析。16 個完整工作簿可調整假設、保存版本及還原輸入；Pro 延續 8 個進階工作台與企業授信模擬器，提供敏感度、三情境比較、決策備忘錄及 CSV 報告。無須帳號，紀錄保存在裝置上。
features: 53 課循序學習
每課以任務、理解、帶做與實作串接案例資料、計算和風險說明；保留測驗、筆記與收藏，並接回上次的課程步驟。
台美機構與實務案例
瀏覽台灣金融機構名錄、美國代表性機構與 22 個虛構實務案例，查看機構、學程與證照資料的來源及日期。
金融地圖與職位路線
7 個領域串連 22 個職位、9 個科系及 27 個課程主題；切換台美市場，查閱學歷條件、先備課程與具名來源，將市場帶入工作簿及能力背景。
免費計算練習、工作簿與 Pro
16 組單變數練習可核對與保存作答，另有 16 個完整工作簿；Pro 延續 8 個進階工作台、雙因子 5 × 5 敏感度、三情境差額、決策備忘錄與 CSV 報告。
語言選擇
介面可選繁中、簡中、英文、德文、泰文、日文、韓文、西班牙文、法文與葡萄牙文。完整課程提供繁中與英文，其他語言的部分介面尚未翻譯，會以英文顯示。
本機學習紀錄
無須註冊，學習與案例資料留在裝置，無廣告、第三方分析追蹤、雲端同步或即時報價；外部來源、購買及回復購買需要網路。
stepDetails: 選擇一堂入門課程，以繁體中文或英文依序閱讀任務、理解、帶做與實作，再透過測驗檢視概念。保留筆記或收藏，也可接續上次的課程步驟；適用課程另有可核對答案、查看解析及保存作答的計算練習。
依類型探索台灣金融機構及美國代表性機構，查看感興趣的機構並進行比較。閱讀每筆資料的來源、日期與欄位狀態；名錄是資料快照，美國資料也不是完整登記冊，需要確認目前資訊時再開啟官方來源。
從金融地圖探索職位與相關證照，沿著 7 個領域、9 個科系及 27 個課程主題整理要學的技能。選擇台灣、美國或台美比較，查閱學歷條件與先備課程；市場背景會帶入相關工作簿與能力分析。分開檢視閱讀、測驗與計算紀錄，自報學歷及學習紀錄不代表資格認證或錄取機率。
more: 在 16 組單變數練習中調整指定假設，計算後核對答案並閱讀解析。作答依課程與市場儲存，閱讀完成、測驗與計算紀錄分開保留。
在 16 個完整工作簿中調整估值、併購、授信、跨境交割及風險情境的多項假設，計算結果、保存版本並還原輸入。相關工作簿沿用所選市場；市場與計價幣別分開，切換幣別不會換匯。
練習現金流或同業估值、槓桿收購、每股盈餘稀釋、綜效出價、授信容量、財務承諾與跨境交割，檢視敏感度及三情境差額，整理決策備忘錄並匯出 CSV。
原有虛構企業授信模擬仍可使用，裝置保留最近 30 次結果。專業分析需有效訂閱；已保存的基準假設仍可在免費工作簿使用。
tips: 機構名錄與考試資訊有資料日期；需要確認當期資訊時，請查閱官方最新公告。
完整課程目前提供繁體中文與英文；其他語言只有部分介面翻譯，未翻譯文字會顯示英文。
Pro 月訂閱與年訂閱提供相同功能。刪除學習資料或 App 不會取消訂閱，請在 Apple 帳號訂閱設定管理。
FinAtlas 用於金融教育與職涯探索，不提供個人化投資建議、真實交易、正式授信決策或資格認證。
計算情境都是虛構教學假設；閱讀完成、測驗與計算紀錄分開，完成閱讀不代表專業熟練認證。

intro: FinAtlas is a guide to financial education and career preparation focused on Taiwan and the United States. Start with seven fields on a financial map, grouped into funding and markets, investing and protection, and operations and controls. Follow links to 22 roles, nine fields of study and 27 academic topics to find a learning route.

Follow 53 lessons through shared foundations, market structure, role methods and application. Each lesson has Task, Method, Demo and Practice sections, and you can resume your last step. Sixteen one-variable calculation exercises let you check answers, read explanations and save attempts by lesson and market, alongside quizzes, notes and bookmarks.

Choose Taiwan, the United States or a comparison of both, and carry market context into related workbooks and preparation profiles. Sixteen full workbooks let you adjust assumptions, save versions and restore inputs. Pro retains eight advanced workbenches and the corporate credit simulator, with sensitivity analysis, three-scenario comparisons, decision memos and CSV reports. No account is required; records stay on your device.
features: 53 lessons, step by step
Follow Task, Method, Demo and Practice sections linked to case facts, calculations and risks. Keep quiz results, notes and bookmarks, and resume your last lesson step.
Taiwan and US institutions and cases
Explore Taiwan institution references, representative US institutions and 22 fictional practical cases, with sources and dates for institution, curriculum and qualification information.
Financial map and career routes

Connect seven fields, 22 roles, nine fields of study and 27 academic topics. Switch markets, check degree guidance, prerequisites and named sources, and carry the market into workbooks and preparation profiles.
Free exercises, workbooks and Pro

Check and save answers in 16 one-variable exercises, alongside 16 full workbooks. Pro retains eight advanced workbenches, two-factor 5 × 5 sensitivity, three-scenario differences, decision memos and CSV reports.
Language options

Choose Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, German, Thai, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French or Portuguese. Full lessons are available in Traditional Chinese and English; other languages have partial interface translations, with English for untranslated text.
Local learning records

No registration is needed. Learning and case records stay on the device, with no ads, third-party analytics, cloud sync or live quotes. External sources, purchases and restoring purchases need internet access.
stepDetails: Choose an introductory lesson in Traditional Chinese or English and follow Task, Method, Demo and Practice, then check your understanding with a quiz. Keep notes or bookmarks and resume your last lesson step. Relevant lessons also offer calculation exercises with answer checking, explanations and saved attempts.

Explore Taiwan financial institutions and representative US institutions by type, open entries that interest you and compare them. Check each entry’s source, date and field status. These are dated snapshots, and the US reference is not a complete register; follow the official source when you need current information.

Explore roles and related qualifications from the financial map, following seven fields, nine fields of study and 27 academic topics to identify skills to learn. Choose Taiwan, the United States or a comparison of both, and check degree guidance and prerequisites. Market context carries into related workbooks and preparation profiles. Review reading, quiz and calculation records separately; self-reported education and learning records are not credentials or hiring probabilities.
more: Change a specified assumption in 16 one-variable exercises, calculate a result, check your answer and read the explanation. Attempts are saved by lesson and market, separately from reading completion and quiz records.

Adjust multiple assumptions in 16 full workbooks covering valuation, mergers and acquisitions, credit, cross-border settlement and risk. Calculate results, save versions and restore inputs. Related workbooks use the selected market; reporting currency is separate, and changing it does not convert amounts.

Practise cash-flow and peer valuation, leveraged buyouts, earnings-per-share dilution, synergy bids, credit capacity, covenants and cross-border settlement. Review sensitivity and three-scenario differences, write decision memos and export CSV reports.

The existing fictional corporate credit simulator remains available and keeps the latest 30 results on the device. Professional analysis requires an active subscription; saved baseline assumptions remain usable in free workbooks.
tips: Institution and examination information has data dates. Check official announcements when you need current information.
Full lessons are currently available in Traditional Chinese and English. Other languages have partial interface translations, with untranslated text shown in English.
Monthly and yearly Pro plans offer the same features. Deleting learning data or the app does not cancel a subscription; manage it in your Apple Account subscription settings.
FinAtlas is for financial education and career exploration. It does not provide personalized investment advice, real trading, formal credit decisions or certification.
Calculation scenarios use fictional teaching assumptions. Reading completion, quizzes and calculations are recorded separately; marking a lesson as read does not certify professional proficiency.
